title: Drop node path does not work in a floating code editor after scrolling
body:
### Tested versions

no floating editor in 4.8.dev4?

Reproducible in 4.8.dev3, 4.8.dev1, 4.7.2.stable, 4.4.1.stable 
Different in 4.3.stable {only occurs if the mouse was moved while scrolling, scrolling with a perfectly still mouse and then releasing does not trigger}
Different in 4.2.stable {seems to consistently be able to get the drop to happen by clicking again after triggering issue, otherwise behaves like 4.3}
Different in 4.1.stable (first release with floating editor) {code window needs to have a scroll bar to trigger}


### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue, 02 Jun 2026 18:26:58 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (nvidia; 610.43.02) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10700K CPU @ 3.80GHz (16 threads) - 31.19 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

Godot v4.7.2.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.7084) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1370P (20 threads) - 31.66 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When dragging a node into a floating code editor, the tip pops up about node path dropping, releasing click will work properly, pasting in the path with modifiers taken into account.
if however, I scroll before releasing (common if you realize you want an export at the top while writing a function lower) releasing no longer does anything.
*edit*
the same behavior occurs for drag and dropping file paths as well

~~This may be a platform specific issue, and I will check on windows tomorrow.~~ same thing on windows

in the video there is an error displayed in my editor, this is triggered if I click to make script editor floating on a non fullscreen editor.  the issue I am raising now happens either way, but this may be a hint so I kept it in.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a604a11e-b2a6-47c2-8fa8-7ca4d681ef24

### Steps to reproduce

Open a project
make a scene
make a script
open the code editor as floating
drag the node into the editor, don't release click
make a scroll input (file does not need to be big enough to have a scrollbar)
release click
observe state is not the expected one

N/A
